text:

the dependency-sensitive generalization rule is not his, since his
generalization rule is unrestricted and the restriction is the hypothesis of
his deduction theorem (\cref{sec:p02-w02c-p02-017-mendelson}).  Kleene
supplies existential-introduction schema 11
reason: Source-fidelity error confirmed against the held Mendelson 4th ed.
